title: Selection controls: select, checkbox, radio, switch, combobox
asA: user making choices in forms and filters
iWant: selection controls that work the way platform controls work
soThat: nothing about choosing options needs learning or fighting

acceptanceCriteria.description: Selects open with Enter, Space, or arrow keys, support arrow navigation and type-ahead within options, commit on Enter, and cancel on Escape restoring the prior value.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the full open, navigate, commit, cancel grammar works

acceptanceCriteria.description: Checkboxes support checked, unchecked, and where used indeterminate, toggle with Space, and expose state changes to assistive technology.
acceptanceCriteria.then: state changes render and announce correctly

acceptanceCriteria.description: Radio groups behave as one Tab stop with arrow keys moving selection within the group, and exactly one selected member.
acceptanceCriteria.then: Tab exits the group, arrows move the selection

acceptanceCriteria.description: Switches expose switch semantics (role and checked state), toggle with Space and Enter, and apply their effect immediately without a separate submit.
acceptanceCriteria.then: semantics announce on and off and the effect applies immediately

acceptanceCriteria.description: Comboboxes implement the filtering pattern: typing filters options, arrows traverse the filtered list, Enter commits, Escape closes without committing, and the expanded state plus active option are exposed programmatically.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the full filter, traverse, commit, cancel grammar works with correct ARIA state

acceptanceCriteria.description: A combobox with no matching options renders a designed empty message inside the listbox, never an empty popup.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a combobox filtered to zero matches
acceptanceCriteria.then: a designed no-matches message is shown

acceptanceCriteria.description: All selection controls render default, hover, focus, disabled, and error states from the token layer in both themes.
acceptanceCriteria.when: each state is induced in both themes

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every selection control meets the 24x24 minimum target size including its label hit area.
acceptanceCriteria.then: each is at least 24x24 CSS pixels
